summary: xAI's Grok for Startups program grants venture-backed startups one credit balance usable across Grok, Grok Build, Grok Bot and the Grok API, sized to about six months of realistic usage. 20% of the grant is released on approval and the remaining 80% after onboarding; credits expire six months after being applied. One grant per company.
claim_steps: Apply at https://x.ai/startups/apply using a work email that matches your company website (personal emails are rejected).
Provide your LinkedIn profile, company website, funding details, revenue, current AI spend, team size and investors.
Eligibility: venture backing and a live product; if you don't qualify yet you can reapply once you've raised.
20% of credits are applied on approval; the other 80% is released automatically after the initial onboarding steps.
